title: Kaeya's Troubles
description: You bump into Kaeya, whom you first met during Stormterror's attack, at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.

mainQuestExcel.title: Kaeya's Troubles
mainQuestExcel.description: You bump into Kaeya, whom you first met during Stormterror's attack, at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.

dialogs.text: This is bad... Such a hassle... What am I going to do...
What's wrong, Kaeya?
#Oh, thank the Thousand Winds! {NICKNAME}, your arrival must be the grace of the gods!
If I may ask — envoy sent by the Anemo God to save this mere mortal — could you spare a moment?
Ewwww, cut it out!
Can't say I don't have time...
Marvelous!
I cannot let my peers hear about this! I cannot seek help from anyone else but you.
Please, let us move to somewhere more fit for such conversations...
Let's talk in the courtyard just outside headquarters. Come with me.
What's with the sneakiness...
Tell me what happened.
You don't usually lose your chill.

flow.stepDescription: Talk to Kaeya at the meeting spot

dialogs.text: I'm a bit busy right now. Do try to find more... clues... You know what I mean.
This place will do.
Tell us what it's about already!
How should I begin... Oh, right, let me tell you a secret first.
It's a secret of my past, and I confide in you to keep it.
Don't worry, Paimon's lips are sealed.
As a matter of fact, my grandfather was a pirate!
Oh.
...Wait, why do you sound so blithe? Do you think I'm making it up?
Look at my eye patch! I inherited it from my grandfather and this is solid proof that we are related by blood!
I never knew you could inherit eye patches.
#My! {NICKNAME}, how could you not know such common knowledge!
This is no different from children inheriting their hairstyles from their parents!
Yesterday I was glancing through the notes my grandfather left and stumbled upon records that spoke of a <color=#00E1FFFF>treasure</color>...
...Treasure!?
According to his notes, the treasure is buried in the "Lost Arcadian Ruins."
Treasure...
But the location of the ruins is currently unknown. I've tried searching for clues...
Treasure!
Kaeya! What kind of treasure is it? Gold? Or better yet, gems!?
Hmph! Treasures that consist of nothing but gold and gems are third-rate treasures...
My grandfather's treasure is a sword!
A magic sword that grants the wielder unrivaled power!
Oh wowwwww!
The sword was dropped from Celestia into the sea by a god. It was later salvaged by my grandfather's crew by pure coincidence.
The moment he gripped the sword, thunder roared, billows howled, and the clear skies were suddenly swallowed by raging winds...
With the might of the magic sword, my grandfather went on to defeat a hydra, a silver-haired banshee, a wicked abyss dragon...
But the immense power of the sword enticed many more greedy pirates.
To avoid meaningless conflicts, my grandfather hid the magic sword.
Eight-headed hydras, silver-haired banshees... Do they really exist?
The world we live in is fascinating, full of unknown and inexplicable wonders.
These incredibly thrilling adventures are romances that could only be told by pirates.
Holy moley! That's just insane!
A gang of <color=#00E1FFFF>Treasure Hoarders</color> has been very active lately and many ruins have had their relics stolen by them.
I'm afraid that they will soon discover the Arcadian Ruins and the magic sword will be lost...
We won't let it fall into the wrong hands! We must get the sword before them.
#You just rest assured that Paimon and {NICKNAME} are here to help!
Wow~
Great! Please keep it a secret. I'll wait for your good news!
#Hey! So whatcha think, {NICKNAME}? Isn't it exciting? We're talking about a super-duper powerful sword!
Is it true?
Well... let's go to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Adventurers' Guild</color> and see if we can find out more.
The adventurers should know more about the ruins, right?
Is it really, really true?
How surprising.

flow.stepDescription: Go to the Adventurers' Guild and listen to their report

dialogs.text: Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins
If you are not here for my stories, we have nothing to talk about.
Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins
Should I go look for it as well...? Oh, haha! I'm just joking. I hope you guys find it!
Hey, kiddo! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild!
I'm Stanley. Remember my name. You're also here for my stories, aren't you?
Hey! Are you a new adventurer? Wanna join my adventure team?
Hmph! We're not here for something that boring!
We're looking for a sword that fell from Celestia... One that can kill eight-headed banshees and silver-haired hydras.
It's eight-headed hydras and silver-haired banshees...
You've said too much.
It's super, mega, uber powerful!
That's what Paimon said! It's a super epic sword!
Anyway, it's fine as long as Paimon doesn't tell them the treasure's location!
It's fine! As long as Paimon doesn't tell them the treasure's location!
(Now she's done it...)
So, Cyrus, do you know where the Lost Arcadian Ruins are supposed to be?
Arcadian Ruins... Never heard of them.
Thanks for your intel anyway. If you do find these ruins, I'd love to see them.
Uh... my... intel...?
We're looking for...
Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins
I am interested in your search, but I just don't have any intel for you.
No. We're here for...
Nope. We just want to know if you've been to the Arcadian Ruins?
Arcadian Ruins? Imagine that... So there are places that I haven't been to...
Oh? Even the great Stanley doesn't know?
Never mind this Arcadia... You need to know what happened to me on the Mare Jivari and in the Geyser Realm...
We don't have time for your stories. Think hard, please. We need clues.
The Mare Jivari... It was a place of death...
Gosh...
When we find the Arcadian<color=#00E1FFFF>treasure</color>, our story will definitely be better than your stupid stories!
(Now she's done it...)
Treasure...? Even Tales too?
Hmph! It's a waste of time talking to him. Let's go already.
Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins
If you are not here for my stories, we have nothing to talk about.
I'd like to ask...
Hey! Do you have any intel on the Arcadian Ruins?
Arcadian... Can't say I've heard of it. Sorry, I'm still new here, so...
Really...
But you can try posting a commission and see if there are any adventurers who know about it.
That's a no-no! No way.
We can't afford them beating us to the treasure!
(Now she's done it...)
Really!?
Well then, I'll keep a lookout for your treasure — I mean, your Arcadian Ruins.
Great! Thanks!
Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins
Should I go look for it as well...? Oh, haha! I'm just joking. I hope you guys find it!
Oh, you're back. Do you have news for me?
Listen, we asked around the Adventurers' Guild and found... Well, nothing.
Haha... That much is expected.
Why is that?
Oh, I only mean that, what's the fun in finding it without the hard work?
However, I do have some clues.
I sent someone to collate black market intel. It seems that someone does know about the Arcadian Ruins.
Really? Where's the guy?
Now, now, as per the black market's rules, they will send someone to meet us to prevent leaks.
We will be meeting the informant at the Whispering Woods.
Then, what are we waiting here for?
It's not ideal for Kaeya to show his face.
That's right. You read my mind.
I am a knight... so I shouldn't have any dealings with the black market.
You have my thanks.
Of course, you'll be compensated for your troubles... by the Knights.
Ooh, no problemo!
We'll get the intel back to you.
Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins
I am interested in your search, but I just don't have any intel for you.
Hey, kiddo! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild!
I'm Stanley. Remember my name. You're also here for my stories, aren't you?
Hey! Are you a new adventurer? Wanna join my adventure team?
